metadata.source: inbox/term2-week13/term2-week13-video-content.md (Week 13); narration supplied verbatim and pre-approved by Janvi (2026-10-28)
metadata.note: Project update, final week of the contract. Thesis: a clean manuscript (tracked changes accepted, markers removed, two wording fixes, full verification run, 30 pages) went to Professor Gultepe; the journal's requirements were checked (abstract 293/300, 8/8 figures and tables, body ~7,600 vs 6,000 guideline, accepted by my professor) and three gaps found and started; terminology decisions explained at standup; the 13-week record compiled and a renewal (Nov 1, 2026 – Feb 20, 2027) proposed. The work is Janvi's. Only Professor Brown and Professor Gultepe may be named. Every on-screen number appears in the Week 13 source as written.

beats.narration_text: Hi, I am Janvi and this video is about the final week of my contract: getting our paper ready to submit. This narration is an AI-generated voice; the work is mine.

beats.role_note: Clean-manuscript checklist: tracked changes accepted · comment markers removed · 2 wording fixes · verification run · '30 pages'; arrow 'to Professor Gultepe'.
beats.narration_text: First, a clean manuscript: all tracked changes accepted, every comment marker removed, two last wording fixes, and a full verification run. It renders at 30 pages. Then it went to Professor Gultepe for a final review.

beats.role_note: Requirements table: abstract 293 / 300 ✓ · figures and tables 8 / 8 ✓ · body ~7,600 / 6,000 guideline 'my professor: acceptable'.
beats.narration_text: Next, the journal's submission requirements. The abstract is 293 words, under 300. Eight figures and tables, right at the limit. The body is about 7,600 words, over the 6,000 guideline, which my professor said is acceptable.
beats.visual_intent: Requirements table: abstract 293 / 300 ✓ · figures and tables 8 / 8 ✓ · body ~7,600 / 6,000 guideline 'my professor: acceptable'.

beats.narration_text: And three gaps: a Statement of Significance, a graphical abstract, and a required declaration of generative AI use. I also confirmed publication is free under Northeastern's agreement.
beats.visual_intent: Three gap cards: Statement of Significance · graphical abstract · generative AI declaration; chip 'no fee under Northeastern's agreement ✓'.

beats.narration_text: I started on those: a Statement of Significance draft, a graphical abstract outline, a cover letter to the editor, and collecting co-author details like ORCIDs and affiliations.
beats.visual_intent: Draft cards: Statement of Significance draft · graphical abstract outline · cover letter · co-author details (ORCIDs, affiliations).

beats.role_note: Two term cards: 'too_basic: a tag, still ships' · 'expert review ≠ audit table'.
beats.narration_text: At standup, I explained two terminology decisions: how the too basic tag works, and why expert review and the audit table are kept as separate terms.
beats.visual_intent: Two term cards: 'too_basic: a tag, still ships' · 'expert review ≠ audit table'.

beats.narration_text: I also compiled the record: detailed reports for all 13 weeks, an updated GitHub repository, and these weekly videos. And I proposed renewing my role from November through February.
beats.visual_intent: Documentation stack: 13 weekly reports · GitHub repository updated · weekly videos; renewal card 'Nov 1, 2026 – Feb 20, 2027'.
